reason: Pulling clean Epicor exports is half a day of work I don't have, and sending PO and job data to an outside startup needs IT and my boss to sign off, which won't happen inside 30 days. I'd take a look if someone else did the export for me.
objection: Our Epicor data leaving the building, even sanitized, will trigger a security review that I don't want to start for a free audit from an early-stage company.
would_change_my_mind: If the export were a short, template-based pull that IT already approved, so it cost me under an hour and nothing that needed a security review.
